decisions.rationale: Neurofibrosarcomas is a single, named tumor disease with one definition and is the disease under study, not a family of diseases.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease mentions

decisions.rationale: Tumor is used as a noun modifier in tumor suppressor gene, a gene class, so the disease term modifies another noun phrase rather than naming a disease on its own.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 - Disease mentions used as Modifiers

decisions.rationale: Solid tumors refers to a family of multiple specific tumor diseases rather than one defined disease, so it is a Disease Class.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Disease Class definition

decisions.rationale: Gastric cancers refers to one specific disease with a single definition (the plural counts cases of it), so it is a Specific Disease and not a general term.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease definition; What NOT to Annotate 4 (cancer retained)

decisions.rationale: Esophageal cancers names one specific disease with a single definition, counted as cases of that disease.

decisions.rationale: Bone and soft tissue tumors of various types describes a broad family of multiple tumor diseases, so it is a Disease Class.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Disease Class definition; Examples 10 and 11

decisions.rationale: Neurofibrosarcomas is a specific named tumor type used for the examined cases, so it is a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease definition

decisions.rationale: Tumor modifies cell lines in tumor cell lines, so the disease term is used as a noun modifier and not as a standalone disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 - Disease mentions used as Modifiers

decisions.rationale: Esophageal cancers is a standalone reference to a specific disease, the source of the 12 cell lines, and does not modify another noun.

decisions.rationale: Glioma and glioblastomas are two separate diseases joined by a slash in one contiguous string, so the string is a Composite Mention.

decisions.rationale: Neurofibrosarcoma modifies patient in neurofibrosarcoma patient, specifying the patient type, so the disease term is used as a modifier.
